title.lg: Sitampu ya LC1 mu Kampala: UGX 10,000

answer.en: In Kampala, the LC1 stamp on your documents costs a flat 10,000 UGX under KCCA by-laws. Never a percentage. Pay at your village LC1 office and get a receipt.
answer.lg: Mu Kampala, sitampu ya LC1 ku bbaluwa zo ya UGX 10,000 zokka ng'amateeka ga KCCA bwe galagira. Si kitundu ku muwendo. Sasira ku offiisi ya LC1 mu kyalo kyo era ofune risiti.
answer.sw: Kampala, muhuri wa LC1 kwenye nyaraka zako ni UGX 10,000 taslimu chini ya sheria ndogo za KCCA. Kamwe si asilimia. Lipia ofisi ya LC1 kijijini kwako na upate risiti.

illegal_practices.en: Any LC1 in Kampala charging more than 10,000 UGX for the stamp is breaking KCCA by-laws. Report to your division office.
illegal_practices.lg: LC1 yonna mu Kampala esasula ennyo okusinga UGX 10,000 ku sitampu emenya amateeka ga KCCA. Gitegeeze ku offiisi ya divizoni yo.
illegal_practices.sw: LC1 yoyote Kampala inayotoza zaidi ya UGX 10,000 kwa muhuri inavunja sheria ndogo za KCCA. Iripoti kwa ofisi ya divisheni yako.

en: Bring your signed document to the LC1 office
Pay exactly 10,000 UGX and get a receipt
Confirm the stamp shows the village name and date
lg: Leeta ebbaluwa yo eriko omukono ku offiisi ya LC1
Sasula UGX 10,000 zokka era ofune risiti
Kakasa nti sitampu eriko erinnya ly'ekyalo n'olunaku
sw: Leta waraka wako uliosainiwa ofisi ya LC1
Lipa UGX 10,000 kamili na upate risiti
Hakikisha muhuri una jina la kijiji na tarehe

question.en: Did you know? The LC1 stamp fee is 10,000 UGX by law. If you are asked to pay more, it is not legal.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? Ssente za sitampu ya LC1 UGX 10,000 ng'etteeka bwe ligamba. Bw'osabibwa osasule ennyo, tekiri mu mateeka.
question.sw: Ulijua? Ada ya muhuri wa LC1 ni UGX 10,000 kisheria. Ukidaiwa kulipa zaidi, si halali.

answer.en: True in Kampala too. Flat 10,000 UGX under KCCA by-laws.
answer.lg: Mazima ne mu Kampala. UGX 10,000 nnyiriri ng'amateeka ga KCCA bwe galagira.
answer.sw: Kweli hata Kampala. UGX 10,000 taslimu chini ya sheria ndogo za KCCA.

title.lg: Ebbaluwa ya LC1 mu Kampala: YA BWEREERE
title.sw: Barua ya utambulisho ya LC1 Kampala: BURE

answer.en: In Kampala, the LC1 introductory letter costs 0 UGX. Free by law. Take your ID to your village LC1 office and collect it the same day.
answer.lg: Mu Kampala, ebbaluwa ya LC1 eya kwanjula ya UGX 0. Ya bwereere ng'etteeka bwe ligamba. Twala ID yo ku offiisi ya LC1 mu kyalo kyo era oggye olunaku olwo.
answer.sw: Kampala, barua ya utambulisho ya LC1 ni UGX 0. Ni bure kisheria. Peleka kitambulisho chako ofisi ya LC1 kijijini kwako na ichukue siku hiyo hiyo.

illegal_practices.en: Charging for this letter in Kampala is illegal. Report fee demands to LC2 or the division office.
illegal_practices.lg: Okusasuza ku bbaluwa eno mu Kampala kimenya mateeka. Abasaba ssente bategeeze ku LC2 oba ku offiisi ya divizoni.
illegal_practices.sw: Kutoza kwa barua hii Kampala ni kinyume cha sheria. Ripoti wanaodai pesa kwa LC2 au ofisi ya divisheni.

en: Go to your LC1 office with your ID
State what the letter is for (passport, NIRA, job)
Collect it free the same day
lg: Genda ku offiisi ya LC1 yo ng'olina ID yo
Tegeeza ky'ogenda okukozesa ebbaluwa (pasipooti, NIRA, mulimu)
sw: Nenda ofisi yako ya LC1 na kitambulisho chako
Eleza barua ni ya nini (pasipoti, NIRA, kazi)

question.en: Did you know? The Kampala LC1 letter is free and ready same day.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? Ebbaluwa ya LC1 mu Kampala ya bwereere era ngyetegefu olunaku olwo.
question.sw: Ulijua? Barua ya LC1 Kampala ni bure na tayari siku hiyo hiyo.

answer.en: Yes. 0 UGX. Carry your ID to the LC1 office.
answer.lg: Yee. UGX 0. Twala ID yo ku offiisi ya LC1.
answer.sw: Ndiyo. UGX 0. Beba kitambulisho chako ofisi ya LC1.

title.en: Report a water outage in Kampala (NWSC)
title.lg: Tegeeza amazzi bwe gaggwaako mu Kampala (NWSC)

answer.en: For water outages in Kampala, call NWSC Kampala branch on 0414-254-460 or visit their office. Give your area, road and account number. NWSC repairs are free. Never pay someone who claims to fix NWSC pipes for cash.
answer.lg: Amazzi bwe gaggwaako mu Kampala, kubira NWSC ku 0414-254-460 oba ogende ku offiisi yaabwe. Wa ekitundu kyo, oluguudo ne namba ya akawunti yo. Okuddaabiriza kwa NWSC kwa bwereere. Tosasa muntu yenna agamba nti addaabiriza ppayipu za NWSC ku ssente.
answer.sw: Maji yakikatika Kampala, pigia NWSC kwa 0414-254-460 au tembelea ofisi yao. Toa eneo lako, barabara na namba ya akaunti yako. Ukarabati wa NWSC ni bure. Usimlipe mtu yeyote anayedai kurekebisha mabomba ya NWSC kwa pesa.

legal_citation: Water Act Cap 152; NWSC service charter

illegal_practices.en: Only NWSC may work on public mains. Private agents demanding cash to restore your water are fraudsters. Report them to NWSC or Police.
illegal_practices.lg: NWSC yokka y'ekkirizibwa okukwata ku ppayipu ez'olukale. Bakayaaya abasaba ssente okuzza amazzi go bafere. Bategeeze ku NWSC oba ku Poliisi.
illegal_practices.sw: NWSC pekee ndiyo inayoruhusiwa kushika mabomba ya umma. Mawakala binafsi wanaodai pesa kurudisha maji yako ni matapeli. Waripoti kwa NWSC au Polisi.

en: Write down your area, road and account number
Call NWSC on 0414-254-460 and get a ticket number
Follow up after 48 hours if water is not back
lg: Wandiika ekitundu kyo, oluguudo ne namba ya akawunti
Kubira NWSC ku 0414-254-460 era ofune namba ya tikiti
Buuzaako nga wayiseewo essaawa 48 amazzi bwe gatanaddayo
sw: Andika eneo lako, barabara na namba ya akaunti
Pigia NWSC kwa 0414-254-460 na upate namba ya tiketi
Fuatilia baada ya saa 48 maji yasiporudi

question.en: Did you know? NWSC repairs in Kampala are free. Call 0414-254-460.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? Okuddaabiriza kwa NWSC mu Kampala kwa bwereere. Kubira 0414-254-460.
question.sw: Ulijua? Ukarabati wa NWSC Kampala ni bure. Pigia 0414-254-460.

answer.en: Yes. Give your area and account number and get a ticket number.
answer.lg: Yee. Wa ekitundu kyo ne namba ya akawunti era ofune namba ya tikiti.
answer.sw: Ndiyo. Toa eneo lako na namba ya akaunti na upate namba ya tiketi.

title.en: Report a power blackout in Kampala (UMEME)
title.lg: Tegeeza amasannyalaze bwe gagenda mu Kampala (UMEME)

answer.en: For power blackouts in Kampala, call UMEME Kampala on 0414-254-460. For fallen wires or danger, call emergency 112 immediately and keep away. Never touch a fallen wire and never pay touts for reconnection.
answer.lg: Amasannyalaze bwe gagenda mu Kampala, kubira UMEME ku 0414-254-460. Ku waya ezigudde oba akabi, kubira em emergency ku 112 mangu era oveewo. Tokwata ku waya egudde era tosasa bakayaaya okukudizaawo.
answer.sw: Umeme ukikatika Kampala, pigia UMEME kwa 0414-254-460. Kwa nyaya zilizoanguka au hatari, pigia dharura 112 mara moja na ukae mbali. Usiguse waya iliyoanguka wala usilipe wahuni kukuunganisha.

illegal_practices.en: Only UMEME may connect or disconnect mains power. Illegal connections can kill you and land you in court. Report power theft to UMEME.
illegal_practices.lg: UMEME yokka y'ekkirizibwa okukwata ku masannyalaze ag'olukale. Okwegatta mu bukyamu kuyinza okukutta era okukutwala mu kkooti. Ababba amasannyalaze bategeeze ku UMEME.
illegal_practices.sw: UMEME pekee ndiyo inayoruhusiwa kuunganisha au kukata umeme wa umma. Miunganisho haramu inaweza kukuua na kukupeleka mahakamani. Ripoti wizi wa umeme kwa UMEME.

en: Check if neighbours also have no power
Call UMEME on 0414-254-460 with your meter number
For fallen wires: call 112, keep people away, wait for UMEME
lg: Kebera oba abaliraanwa nabo tebalina masannyalaze
Kubira UMEME ku 0414-254-460 ng'olina namba ya mita yo
Ku waya ezigudde: kubira 112, goba abantu, linda UMEME
sw: Angalia kama majirani pia hawana umeme
Pigia UMEME kwa 0414-254-460 ukiwa na namba ya mita yako
Kwa nyaya zilizoanguka: pigia 112, waweke watu mbali, subiri UMEME

question.en: Did you know? Fallen power wire? Call 112 and stay away.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? Waya y'amasannyalaze bw'egwa? Kubira 112 era oveewo.
question.sw: Ulijua? Waya ya umeme ikianguka? Pigia 112 na ukae mbali.

answer.en: Yes. Never touch it. Only UMEME handles mains wires.
answer.lg: Yee. Togikwatako. UMEME yokka y'ekwata ku waya ez'olukale.
answer.sw: Ndiyo. Usiguse. UMEME pekee ndiyo hushika nyaya za umma.

title.en: Check planned road closures (KCCA road works)
title.lg: Kebera enguudo ze bagenda okuggala (emirimu gya KCCA)
title.sw: Angalia kufungwa kwa barabara kulikopangwa (kazi za KCCA)

answer.en: KCCA announces planned road closures before road works start. Ask at your KCCA division office or call 0414-254-460 to check which roads are closed and the diversion routes. Plan extra travel time on work days.
answer.lg: KCCA elangirira enguudo ze bagenda okuggala nga emirimu teginnatandika. Buuza ku offiisi ya KCCA eya divizoni yo oba okubire ku 0414-254-460 okimanye enguudo eziggaddwa n'amakkubo agakyusiddwa. Tegeka essaawa endala ez'okutambula ku nnaku z'emirimu.
answer.sw: KCCA hutangaza kufungwa kwa barabara kulikopangwa kabla kazi haijaanza. Uliza ofisi ya KCCA ya divisheni yako au pigia 0414-254-460 ujue barabara zilizofungwa na njia mbadala. Panga muda wa ziada wa safari siku za kazi.

illegal_practices.en: Nobody may block a public road or charge drivers a private diversion fee during works. Report road blockers to KCCA or Traffic Police.
illegal_practices.lg: Tewali akkirizibwa kuziba luguudo lwa lukale oba kusasuza madereeva ssente za kyama mu kiseera ky'emirimu. Abaziba enguudo bategeeze ku KCCA oba ku Traffic Police.
illegal_practices.sw: Hakuna anayeruhusiwa kuziba barabara ya umma au kutoza madereva ada binafsi wakati wa kazi. Ripoti wanaoziba barabara kwa KCCA au Polisi wa Trafiki.

en: Call KCCA on 0414-254-460 before long trips
Ask boda and taxi stages about diversions too
Leave home earlier on road-work days
lg: Kubira KCCA ku 0414-254-460 nga tonnaba kutambula wala
Buuza ne ku siteegi za boda ne takisi ku makubo agakyusiddwa
Vaayo mangu ku nnaku ez'emirimu gy'enguudo
sw: Pigia KCCA kwa 0414-254-460 kabla ya safari ndefu
Uliza pia vituo vya boda na taksi kuhusu njia mbadala
Ondoka nyumbani mapema siku za kazi za barabara

question.en: Did you know? KCCA announces road closures before works start.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? KCCA elangirira enguudo eziggala nga emirimu teginnatandika.
question.sw: Ulijua? KCCA hutangaza kufungwa kwa barabara kabla kazi haijaanza.

answer.en: Yes. Call 0414-254-460 and plan extra travel time.
answer.lg: Yee. Kubira 0414-254-460 era otegeke essaawa endala ez'okutambula.
answer.sw: Ndiyo. Pigia 0414-254-460 na upange muda wa ziada wa safari.

title.en: KCCA waste collection schedule by division
title.lg: Enteekateeka ya KCCA ey'okuyonja kasasiro mu buli divizoni
title.sw: Ratiba ya ukusanyaji taka ya KCCA kwa divisheni

answer.en: KCCA collects waste on a schedule set per division. Ask your division office for your parish collection days. Bag your waste and put it out on time. If collection is missed, report to the division office with your parish name. Dumping in trenches is illegal and fined.
answer.lg: KCCA eyoonja kasasiro ng'enteekateeka bw'eri mu buli divizoni. Buuza ku offiisi ya divizoni yo ennaku ez'okuyonja mu muluka gwo. Teeka kasasiro wo mu bupaveera era ogufulumye mu kiseera. Bwe gatalonjjebwa, tegeeza ku offiisi ya divizoni ng'olina erinnya ly'omuluka gwo. Okuyiwa mu mifere kimenya mateeka era kirina engassi.
answer.sw: KCCA hukusanya taka kwa ratiba iliyowekwa kwa kila divisheni. Uliza ofisi ya divisheni yako siku za ukusanyaji za parishi yako. Funga taka zako na uzitoe kwa wakati. Ukusanyaji ukikosa, ripoti kwa ofisi ya divisheni ukiwa na jina la parishi yako. Kutupa mitaroni ni haramu na kuna faini.

illegal_practices.en: Dumping waste in trenches, roadsides or wetlands attracts a fine and cleanup costs. Private collectors must be licensed by KCCA.
illegal_practices.lg: Okuyiwa kasasiro mu mifere, ku mabbali g'enguudo oba mu bitosi kireeta engassi n'omutango gw'okuyonja. Abayonja ab'ekinnansi balina okuba ne layisinsi ya KCCA.
illegal_practices.sw: Kutupa taka mitaroni, kando ya barabara au mabwawa huleta faini na gharama za usafi. Wakusanyaji binafsi lazima wawe na leseni ya KCCA.

en: Get your parish collection days from the division office
Bag waste and place it out on collection morning
Report missed collection with your parish name
lg: Funa ennaku z'omuluka gwo okuva ku offiisi ya divizoni
Teeka kasasiro mu bupaveera era ogufulumye ku makya ag'okuyonja
Tegeeza bwe batalonja ng'olina erinnya ly'omuluka gwo
sw: Pata siku za parishi yako kutoka ofisi ya divisheni
Funga taka na uziweke nje asubuhi ya ukusanyaji
Ripoti ukusanyaji uliokosekana ukiwa na jina la parishi yako

question.en: Did you know? Dumping in trenches is fined in Kampala.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? Okuyiwa mu mifere kirina engassi mu Kampala.
question.sw: Ulijua? Kutupa mitaroni kuna faini Kampala.

answer.en: Yes. Bag waste, follow your parish schedule, report misses.
answer.lg: Yee. Teeka kasasiro mu bupaveera, goberera enteekateeka y'omuluka, tegeeza bwe batalonja.
answer.sw: Ndiyo. Funga taka, fuata ratiba ya parishi, ripoti zilizokosekana.

title.lg: Permit ya bizinensi entono eya KCCA: UGX 50,000
title.sw: Kibali cha biashara ndogo cha KCCA: UGX 50,000

answer.en: A small business permit in Kampala costs 50,000 UGX at the KCCA Revenue Department. Carry your national ID, site sketch and LC1 letter. Pay officially and keep the receipt. Operating without a permit brings fines and closure.
answer.lg: Permit ya bizinensi entono mu Kampala ya UGX 50,000 ku KCCA Revenue Department. Twala ID yo ey'eggwanga, akapande k'ekifo n'ebbaluwa ya LC1. Sasula mu ngeri entuufu era okwate risiti. Okukola nga tolina permit kireeta engassi n'okuggalawo.
answer.sw: Kibali cha biashara ndogo Kampala ni UGX 50,000 Idara ya Mapato ya KCCA. Beba kitambulisho chako cha taifa, mchoro wa eneo na barua ya LC1. Lipa rasmi na uhifadhi risiti. Kufanya kazi bila kibali huleta faini na kufungwa.

illegal_practices.en: Pay only at KCCA offices or official channels with a receipt. Collectors without receipts and uniforms pocketing your money are thieves. Report them to KCCA or Police.
illegal_practices.lg: Sasula kwokka ku offiisi za KCCA oba mu ngeri entuufu ng'ofuna risiti. Abasolooza abatalina risiti ne yunifoomu abakwata ssente zo babbi. Bategeeze ku KCCA oba ku Poliisi.
illegal_practices.sw: Lipa tu ofisi za KCCA au njia rasmi na upate risiti. Wakusanyaji bila risiti na sare wanaochukua pesa zako ni wezi. Waripoti kwa KCCA au Polisi.

en: Get your LC1 letter and draw a simple site sketch
Visit KCCA Revenue Department with your ID
Pay 50,000 UGX officially and display the permit at your shop
lg: Funa ebbaluwa ya LC1 era okube akapande k'ekifo
Genda ku KCCA Revenue Department ng'olina ID yo
Sasula UGX 50,000 mu ngeri entuufu era oteeke permit mu duuka lyo
sw: Pata barua yako ya LC1 na uchore mchoro rahisi wa eneo
Tembelea Idara ya Mapato ya KCCA na kitambulisho chako
Lipa UGX 50,000 rasmi na ubandike kibali dukani kwako

question.en: Did you know? A small Kampala business permit is 50,000 UGX with a receipt.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? Permit ya bizinensi entono mu Kampala ya UGX 50,000 ne risiti.
question.sw: Ulijua? Kibali cha biashara ndogo Kampala ni UGX 50,000 na risiti.

answer.en: Yes. ID, site sketch and LC1 letter at KCCA Revenue. No receipt, no payment.
answer.lg: Yee. ID, akapande k'ekifo n'ebbaluwa ya LC1 ku KCCA Revenue. Awatali risiti, tosasa.
answer.sw: Ndiyo. Kitambulisho, mchoro wa eneo na barua ya LC1 Idara ya Mapato. Hakuna risiti, hakuna malipo.

title.en: Enroll your child in a Kampala public school
title.lg: Wandiisa omwana wo mu ssomero lya gavumenti mu Kampala
title.sw: Msajili mwanao shule ya umma Kampala

answer.en: To enroll in a Kampala public school, visit the school with the child's birth certificate and your ID. UPE schools charge no tuition. Orphans can get a full fee waiver: apply at the Division Education Office with the death certificate and LC1 letter.
answer.lg: Okuwandiisa mu ssomero lya gavumenti mu Kampala, genda ku ssomero ng'olina birth certificate y'omwana ne ID yo. Amasomero ga UPE tegalina ssente za kusoma. Abamulekwa basobola okufuna okusonyiyibwa ssente zonna: saba ku offiisi y'eby'enjigiriza eya divizoni ng'olina death certificate n'ebbaluwa ya LC1.
answer.sw: Kumsajili shule ya umma Kampala, tembelea shule na cheti cha kuzaliwa cha mtoto na kitambulisho chako. Shule za UPE hazitozi karo. Mayatima wanaweza kupata msamaha kamili wa ada: omba Ofisi ya Elimu ya Divisheni ukiwa na cheti cha kifo na barua ya LC1.

illegal_practices.en: No public UPE school may charge tuition or send children home for development fees. Report such schools to the Division Education Office.
illegal_practices.lg: Tewali ssomero lya UPE erikkirizibwa kusasuza ssente za kusoma oba okugoba abaana olw'ensimbi ez'enkulaakulana. Amasomero ago gategeeze ku offiisi y'eby'enjigiriza eya divizoni.
illegal_practices.sw: Hakuna shule ya umma ya UPE inayoruhusiwa kutoza karo au kuwafukuza watoto kwa ada za maendeleo. Ripoti shule hizo Ofisi ya Elimu ya Divisheni.

en: Visit the nearest public school with birth certificate and ID
Fill the enrollment form with the head teacher
For orphans: apply for the waiver at the Division Education Office
lg: Genda ku ssomero lya gavumenti erisinga okumpi ng'olina birth certificate ne ID
Jjuza foomu y'okuwandiisa ng'oli ne head teacher
Ku bamulekwa: saba okusonyiyibwa ku offiisi y'eby'enjigiriza eya divizoni
sw: Tembelea shule ya umma iliyo karibu na cheti cha kuzaliwa na kitambulisho
Jaza fomu ya usajili na mwalimu mkuu
Kwa mayatima: omba msamaha Ofisi ya Elimu ya Divisheni

question.en: Did you know? UPE schools charge no tuition, and orphans get waivers.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? Amasomero ga UPE tegalina ssente za kusoma, era abamulekwa basonyiyibwa.
question.sw: Ulijua? Shule za UPE hazitozi karo, na mayatima hupata misamaha.

answer.en: Yes. Report any UPE school charging tuition to the Division office.
answer.lg: Yee. Tegeeza essomero lya UPE lyonna erisasuza ssente za kusoma ku offiisi ya divizoni.
answer.sw: Ndiyo. Ripoti shule yoyote ya UPE inayotoza karo kwa ofisi ya divisheni.
